profile.description: Specialized in Vue and React ecosystems. Proven track record in developing complex, scalable systems for aviation, digital agencies, and large-scale distribution sectors. Expert in FSD (Feature-Sliced Design) architecture, REST API consumption, and real-time data integration via WebSockets. Focused on code performance, scalable architecture, and business process automation. Actively utilize TypeScript and GitLab CI/CD to ensure high-quality delivery, while systematically integrating AI-driven development workflows.

ai.title: AI & Development Velocity
ai.description: By leveraging LLMs and AI-powered tools, I significantly accelerate code generation, automate unit testing, and streamline complex debugging. My approach combines deep architectural knowledge with AI efficiency to optimize development lifecycles, allowing for a dedicated focus on solving high-level business challenges and ensuring system reliability.
